topic: Continuous radio-style music queue on rock1 (yubiOS skills/radio-queue/SKILL.md): on-device yt-dlp + ffmpeg downloads, queue.txt append interface, daemon transcoding to stereo 44.1 kHz PCM, ES8316 mixer locked at 100 percent per song, and a background prequeue worker that eliminates inter-track gaps.

subtopics.scope: Why the queue exists: moving downloads off the Sauna-to-rock1 shell bridge, the per-song Tailscale Funnel round-trip problem of the parent play-audio-on-rock1 skill, and the user-driven design directives.
seed_queries: Tailscale Funnel expose local service to the public internet how it works
base64 encoding transfer size overhead efficiency

subtopics.scope: The /tmp/audio/queue/ directory layout, the current.* foreground and next.* background pipelines, the daemon's three per-song phases, and the five-step per-track pipeline.

yt-dlp and ffmpeg on-device: format selection (-f bestaudio, -x --audio-format mp3), --no-check-certificates, zipapp vs standalone binary install and the Python 3.10+ shebang rewrite, plus YouTube bot-detection workarounds (folded from the dropped bot-detection subtopic).
seed_queries: yt-dlp format selection bestaudio extract audio flags documentation
yt-dlp installation standalone binary zipapp python options

subtopics.scope: ffmpeg transcode to raw PCM s16le stereo 44100 Hz (CD quality), playback through ALSA device hw:1,0, and the ES8316 codec mixer locked at 100 percent before every song.
seed_queries: ffmpeg convert audio raw pcm s16le 44100 stereo output format
ES8316 codec Linux ALSA Rockchip audio mixer amixer

subtopics.scope: The background prequeue worker pattern: overlapping the next track's download/transcode with current playback, the prequeue.lock single-worker guard, the atomic next.* to current.* swap, and fallback to cold download on failure.
seed_queries: gapless playback preload next track background worker design pattern
prefetch pipeline overlap download processing latency queue producer consumer

subtopics.scope: The queue.txt append interface, per-line clip args |start=N|duration=M, the queue.sh helper verbs (add/list/clear/status/skip/stop), and one-shot deployment of install.sh and the daemon.

Probing URLs with yt-dlp --skip-download --dump-single-json before queueing, the Video unavailable failure mode (burned queue slots, polluted logs, forced cold downloads), and the verified example playlists.

subtopics.scope: Stopping cleanly when play2.py runs as root: the sudo /proc walk to find surviving PIDs, the pkill -f self-match hazard, daemon error resilience, the 5-second idle poll, and queue.log truncation at 200 KB.

subtopics.scope: The shipped example playlists (classic-rock, upbeat-verified, jacob-collier, lofi-verified, samplman full-channel dump archetype), their yt-dlp verification discipline, and the file inventory of the skill.
